column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/hoist_at_derived_values.onsa tests=5 evaluated=5 unavailable=0 skipped=0 waiting=0
@ a computed part of a ratio read at sample is twice the p of the call that reads it
init 0 hoist_at_derived_values.computed_part sr=0x41000000
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=1 in x=[0x40400000]
process 0 params p=0x40a00000 frames=1 in x=[0x40400000]
@ the name of a ratio read at sample after a computation is twice the p of the call that reads it
init 0 hoist_at_derived_values.let_of_a_ratio sr=0x41000000
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=2 in x=[0x40400000 0x40800000]
process 0 params p=0x40a00000 frames=2 in x=[0x40400000 0x40800000]
@ a ratio of a type with no Default is read at sample: no field of a tick, so E0816 does not apply
render hoist_at_derived_values.no_default sr=0x41000000 params p={0x3fc00000} in x=[0x40400000]
@ a division at a ratio of a block value panics in a call of 0 frames (the block stage)
init 0 hoist_at_derived_values.divided_at_a_ratio sr=0x41000000
process 0 params n=6 m=0 frames=0 in x=[]
panic block
@ a division at a ratio of a block value gives its value: 6 / 3 = 2
render hoist_at_derived_values.divided_at_a_ratio sr=0x41000000 params n=6 m=3 in x=[1 10]
